items.title: Remove caravan and wooden extension
items.quote: Sie haben den auf dem Grundstück Fl.-Nr. 412/3 abgestellten Wohnwagen samt dem angebauten Holzvorbau bis spätestens 26.02.2027 zu entfernen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for compliance: 'bis spätestens 26.02.2027'. No counting is needed; the date is printed directly and is a Friday, a normal business day, so it stands as the final day.

items.quote: Für den Fall, dass Sie Nr. 1 nicht rechtzeitig erfüllen, wird ein Zwangsgeld von 2.000 € angedroht.

items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) with the Bavarian Administrative Court
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Bayerischen Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg, Haidplatz 4, 93047 Musterregensburg erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Geschäftsstelle des Gerichts.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026, sent by ordinary post. Under Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting = Sun 22.11.2026 (this day does not shift for deemed-delivery purposes). The one-month Klage period under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB starts the next day (23.11.2026) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: Tue 22.12.2026. That day is a normal business day (no weekend/holiday shift needed). Note: if this matter (based on the prior Anhörungsverfahren mentioned in the letter) was already pending before 1 January 2025, Bavaria's transitional rule (Art. 98 BayVwVfG) could instead apply the old 3-day deemed-delivery rule, moving delivery to Sat 21.11.2026 and the deadline to Mon 21.12.2026 - one day earlier. To be safe, treat 21.12.2026 as the effective last safe day and do not wait until 22.12.2026.

warnings: The letter states no Widerspruch is available ('Ein Widerspruchsverfahren ist in dieser Sache nicht vorgesehen') - only Klage directly to the Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg.

Because the letter mentions a prior Anhörungsverfahren (hearing procedure), the underlying administrative matter may have begun before 1 January 2025, in which case Bavaria's transitional rule (Art. 98 BayVwVfG) could apply the older 3-day deemed-delivery period instead of 4 days, shifting both the deemed-delivery date and the Klage deadline one day earlier (delivery on 21.11.2026, deadline 21.12.2026 instead of 22.12.2026); treat 21.12.2026 as the safe deadline.
The €2,000 Zwangsgeld (penalty payment) is only a threat conditional on missing the removal deadline of 26.02.2027, not an immediate payment demand.
Verify the IBAN DE88 7435 1000 0002 0007 00 independently before any payment, as no payment is currently due under this letter.
